checks.note: The evidence packet lists e2 as material counterevidence, but the payload labels e2 'supports' and never tells readers that counterevidence was considered. That relation is inconsistent with the frozen case. Also, e2 reports a relative tradeoff (7% lower out-of-distribution accuracy than linear probing), and e1 is a survey of challenges on graph data. Neither documents 'substantial failures' as the rationale says. The excerpt, the 2022 period, the dates and the outcome (supported) are otherwise correct.
